description: This file contains C source code implementing process checkpointing and wakeup functions within a module named 'CheckpointLib'. It manages process state serialization using external memory checkpointing functions, handles internal metadata, and exposes functions for hibernating and waking up processes.

methods.name: uint32_t HibernateProcess(const uint32_t timeout,const pid_t pid,const char data_dir[],const char volatile_dir[],void ** storage)
methods.description: Performs a checkpoint of the specified process identified by pid, saving its state to the provided data directories, with a timeout. Uses external MEMCR_Checkpoint function.

methods.name: uint32_t WakeupProcess(const uint32_t timeout,const pid_t pid,const char data_dir[],const char volatile_dir[],void ** storage)
methods.description: Resumes a previously checkpointed process using the provided pid, freeing associated metadata. Uses external MEMCR_Resume function.
